title: New Weapon surrender Bin
summary: A new weapon surrender bin has been installed in Coventry as part of ongoing action to prevent and tackle knife crime and remove dangerous weapons from communities.

title: Council's digital programme wins national award for diversity and inclusion strategy
summary: The Council's digital inclusion programme, #CovConnects, has won the Diversity and Inclusion Strategy of the Year award at the prestigious Women in Green Business Awards

title: Ask me what matters: care experienced young people tell professionals what they want to be asked
summary: A new initiative to ensure children in care and care leavers are asked about the things that really matter to them was launched today – with the help of Coventry City Council.

title: Coventry City Council supports Kinship Care Week 2026
summary: Coventry City Council is proud to support Kinship Care Week.

title: Preventing Ketamine drug use in Coventry
summary: Ketamine use is rising across the country and in Coventry.

title: Coventry Market set for £1.25 million upgrade
summary: Coventry’s much-loved and Grade II listed indoor market is to benefit from external improvements after a commitment to invest at least £1.25 million.
